summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the results of S&T Bancorp's 2026 annual meeting, including election of directors, ratification of auditor, and advisory vote on executive compensation under Item 5.07, plus a board committee reorganization under Item 8.01. No transaction, shareholder activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is described. The report is a routine current report on ordinary corporate governance matters and does not constitute a special situation filing.
